sources.snippet: MossFormer2 is a hybrid neural architecture developed for enhanced time-domain monaural speech separation, integrating Transformer-based self-attention with an RNN-free recurrent module. Leveraging feedforward sequential memory networks (FSMNs) and gated convolutional units, MossFormer2 effectively models both long-range dependencies and fine-scale recurrent patterns in speech signals.
